name: global-all-champions-p1
description: Every model the second global league ever crowned (210: 8 first champions, 202 new), one quick arena at ply 1 (the league's ply), T 0.02, hybrid17, 4 double round-robins (~1,670 games each). The user, 11-12 ~09:35: "Run all the champion models in 1 quick arena to see how they all compare" (after killing the league; "They probably began to get worse at this point").
